mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or CPI YoY > 2% does not correlate with subsequent tightening actions by the Fed.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in Real Final Sales of Goods signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or RSAFS decline does not correlate with subsequent economic slowdowns.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals labor market distress, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or UNRATE spike does not correlate with subsequent economic weakness.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) signals strengthening supply-side fundamentals, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or INDPRO increase does not correlate with subsequent economic expansion.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS is below 1% and CPIAUCSL YoY is above 2%, the combination signals a potential stagflationary environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the combination of low FEDFUNDS and high CPIAUCSL does not correlate with subsequent stagflationary periods.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in Housing Starts (HOUST) signals strengthening demand in the housing sector, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or HOUST increase does not correlate with subsequent economic expansion.

mechanism_narrative: When UNRATE is above 8% and PAYEMS shows negative growth for two consecutive months, it signals a severe labor market contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE > 8% and PAYEMS declines for 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the combination of high UNRATE and declining PAYEMS does not correlate with subsequent economic contractions.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in FEDFUNDS signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of instances despite the negative signal, or FEDFUNDS increase does not correlate with subsequent tightening actions by the Fed.
